metadata.description: Wilson coefficients for this HEFT configuration. SM couplings are at their SM value (Kappa framework: 1; Delta framework: 0); every effective coefficient is at InitialiseWCs. Edit the values in wcxf/wcxf_output.json (cell 4) to change them. A value of 0 is simply 0 in the exported model; operator selection is NLOOperators alone. Cell 3 rewrites this file back to the defaults.
